Name: Spouses In Ginger Island Fix
Author: AlanBF
Description:
Every 10 in-game minutes this error pops up?

[code][12:37:48 ERROR Spouses' Island] This mod failed in the GameLoop.TimeChanged event. Technical details:
NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.
   at SpousesIsland.Events.Time.OnChange(Object sender, TimeChangedEventArgs e)
   at StardewModdingAPI.Framework.Events.ManagedEvent`1.Raise(TEventArgs args)[/code]
It's because the mod looks for a list of valid spouses, but it only create that list if you already unlocked the Island House Upgrade.

I just added

[code]if(Upgrade not unlocked):
Do nothing.[/code]
That's all.

Manifest.Name: Spouses In Ginger Island Fix
